description: Factual questions about the text of the EU AI Act (original 2024 version), used to compare RAG architectures. Not legal advice: systems are evaluated, not the law.

documents.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), original Official Journal text

corpus.version_note: Original 2024 text, before the Digital Omnibus on AI (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, in force 27 July 2026). Questions flagged version_sensitive may differ under the current law and stay in the dev split.

annotation_rules: An answerable question must be answerable from the frozen corpus alone.
Each required fact is one atomic claim with anchors_any: short phrases that must appear in a retrieved passage for the fact to count as covered. Anchors are independent of chunking.
anchors_verified is true only for anchors copied from passages the annotator pasted; every anchor must still be checked against the real passages file with check_anchors.py.
gold_paragraph_ids are human-readable references only and never enter metric computation.
An unanswerable question must look like a real question and must not mention passages, context or fiction. Confirm absence with absence_terms and a manual read.
Questions were drafted with LLM assistance and must be reviewed by a human before status becomes reviewed. State this in the README.
Do not edit a test question after the freeze.
